content: In this proceeding, a creditor sought the division of property pignorated from spouses in a legal community. During the trial, one of the assets was sold in a separate enforcement procedure where the creditor had already intervened. The legal problem concerned the survival of the interest to act (interesse ad agire) under Art. 100 CPC. The Court applied the principle of "cessazione della materia del contendere" (mootness), ruling that when a common asset is liquidated in a parallel proceeding, the judicial division becomes redundant as the creditor’s satisfaction will occur through the distribution of proceeds in that separate action. ID: ITD035; Instance_Type: First instance; Legal_Duration: P2Y10M; Law: IT – Civil Code – 191, 210(3); State: IT; Type: Property adjustment within Legal separation; Costs: Both; Marital_Regime: Community of property; Immovable_Assets: Land ; law: Inheritance
